# gpcn_vpc_subnet (Resource)

Manages a subnet inside a GPCN VPC. A subnet carves a block out of the VPC super-CIDR and binds it to a network security group. The API key needs vpc:read to read a subnet, and vpc-subnet:create, vpc-subnet:update and vpc-subnet:delete to manage one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Carving subnets out of a GPCN VPC
#
# A subnet takes its datacenter and its address space from its VPC. Give it a
# CIDR inside the VPC super-CIDR. You can instead give a prefix length and let
# GPCN carve a free block of that size.

terraform {
  required_providers {
    gpcn = {
      source  = "Global-Private-Cloud-Network/gpcn"
      version = "~>1.4.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "gpcn" {
  host = "https://api.gpcn.com"
}

# Lookup datacenter in Central US region
data "gpcn_datacenters" "central_us" {
  country_name = "United States"
  region_name  = "Central"
  name         = "Chicago"
}

resource "gpcn_vpc" "example" {
  name          = "terraform-demo-vpc"
  datacenter_id = data.gpcn_datacenters.central_us.datacenters[0].id
  cidr          = "10.60.0.0/16"
}

# A subnet with an explicit CIDR inside the VPC super-CIDR
resource "gpcn_vpc_subnet" "example_explicit" {
  vpc_id      = gpcn_vpc.example.id
  name        = "terraform-demo-web"
  description = "Web tier"
  cidr        = "10.60.1.0/24"
}

# A subnet GPCN carves: ask for a size and let the allocator pick the block
resource "gpcn_vpc_subnet" "example_carved" {
  vpc_id = gpcn_vpc.example.id
  name   = "terraform-demo-data"
  prefix = 26
}

output "gpcn_vpc_subnet_example_explicit" {
  value = gpcn_vpc_subnet.example_explicit
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable name for the subnet. It must be unique within the VPC
- `vpc_id` (String) Unique identifier of the VPC the subnet is carved from. Changing this value requires replacing the subnet

### Optional

- `cidr` (String) CIDR block for the subnet, which must lie inside the VPC super-CIDR (e.g., 10.50.1.0/24). If omitted, GPCN carves a free block of the requested prefix length. Changing this value requires replacing the subnet
- `description` (String) Additional information about the subnet to provide context for its purpose
- `nsg_id` (String) Unique identifier of the network security group the subnet is bound to. If omitted, GPCN binds the VPC's default group. Changing this value rebinds the subnet in place
- `prefix` (Number) Prefix length of the block to carve when cidr is omitted, between 22 and 28. GPCN defaults to 24. The API never reports it, so the provider reads it from the CIDR's mask length. Changing this value requires replacing the subnet

### Read-Only

- `attached_nic_count` (Number) The number of live network interfaces attached to this subnet. GPCN refuses to delete a subnet while this count is above zero
- `created_time` (String) Timestamp when the subnet was created
- `failure_reason` (String) Why the last operation on the subnet failed, or null when none has
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the subnet in UUID format
- `last_updated` (String) Timestamp when the subnet was last updated
- `nsg_name` (String) Name of the network security group the subnet is bound to
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state of the subnet: one of 'creating', 'ready', 'failed' or 'removing'

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A subnet is read through its VPC's listing, so the import ID names both:
# "<vpc_id>/<subnet_id>".
terraform import gpcn_vpc_subnet.example_explicit "c13808d9-3b7d-42c5-a21d-f0961308a38a/8f1a4c02-1d0e-4a6b-9f3e-2b7c5d914e60"
```
